  (source, external_id, hash_dedup, title, description, url_original, store, image_url, price_current, raw_payload)
VALUES
  ('{{ $json.source }}', '{{ $json.external_id }}', '{{ $json.hash_dedup }}',
   '{{ $json.title }}', '{{ $json.description }}', '{{ $json.url_original }}',
   '{{ $json.store }}', '{{ $json.image_url }}', {{ $json.price_current }},
   '{{ JSON.stringify($json.raw_payload) }}'::jsonb)
ON CONFLICT (hash_dedup) DO NOTHING;
